zh.title: 彩虹时段与紧凑规划界面
zh.summary: 新增彩虹几何时段，统一日期时间、表格和说明展示。

items.text: 日虹与月虹新增主虹、副虹当日几何时段及持续时间，与角度横向并排展示；时段不保证彩虹出现。
日期与时间合并为居中的一体选择器，压缩表格列宽和观测卡片间距，统一下拉居中、表头加粗与 h/m 时长单位。
重新组织并精简中英文使用说明，天气图例按需展开；统一移动端导航 Tab 宽度。

en.title: Rainbow windows and compact planning
en.summary: Adds geometric rainbow windows and streamlines date, time, tables and guidance.

items.text: Shows daily primary and secondary sunbow/moonbow windows and durations alongside angles. Geometric windows do not guarantee rainbow occurrence.
Combines date and time in one centred picker, tightens table columns and observing cards, and standardizes centred selectors, bold headers and h/m duration units.
Reorganizes and shortens the Chinese and English guide, makes weather legends expandable and equalizes mobile navigation tab widths.
